title_original: FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust
description: Microsoft FORGE Lab researchers found memory-safety bugs in Rust's core and std libraries, including cases where safe Rust code can trigger undefined behavior. Using Hyenas, FORGE's frontier research version of codename MDASH, the team investigated three patterns of misplaced trust in unsafe code and what they reveal about Rust's safety guarantees.The postFORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rustappeared first onMicrosoft Security Blog.

title_original: Cato CTRL Threat Intel: PHP2Shell in the Underground and the Search for a Working Exploit
description: Executive summary On October 21, 2026, we observed participants in underground forums seeking PHP2Shell exploits, while others shared scripts presented as exploiting CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Discussion included doubts about prerequisites and whether circulating code worked. This post examines that gap between interest, claimed capability, and verified exploitation.
